title: Same-partition CoRichards numerical viability curve

terminology.CoRichards: Conventional Reference-Richards discretisation run on exactly the same fixed vertical partition and therefore the same number of spatial prognostic water states as the corresponding LARE R_N member.
terminology.purpose: equal-representation-complexity comparator, not numerical-equivalence target and not production route

predecessor_findings.C4O: No single zero-fit Wb/Wt/H-conditioned scalar internal-gradient correction transfers across both 2.5 and 5 cm terminal representations; return to representation selection.
predecessor_findings.DYN0A_CRQ: R2/R3 equal-dimension CoRichards dynamic cases remained numerically blocked under the frozen strict Reference authority through 16 temporal substeps. This is a comparator qualification blocker, not evidence of LARE hydrological superiority.
predecessor_findings.DYN0A_RL1: Standard LARE is resolution-convergent on the nested R3-R16 ladder; R16 is a no-spatial-reduction control.

scientific_question: At what spatial state dimensions, if any below the 16-node fine Reference grid, does conventional same-partition Richards become a numerically qualified dynamic comparator under the already-frozen DYN0A B01 fixed-flux laboratory and strict Reference authority?

scope.bottom_boundary: fixed downward flux equal to initial equilibrium K0

spatial_governance: All partitions are copied unchanged from LARE_DYN0A_RL1_PREREGISTRATION.json.
No partition may be moved, inserted or removed after observing Q1.
R16 is a numerical authority/control, not a reduced model.

numerical_route.reference_binding: current research Reference-Richards route frozen by the DYN0A harness; no src/reference changes
numerical_route.forcing_rule: piecewise constant over the original observation interval; forcing change indices remain unchanged
numerical_route.committed_sampling: only states on the original 0.0008-day observation grid enter convergence diagnostics
numerical_route.fallback_policy: exact inherited DYN0A strict-first research policy; no new failure class, tolerance relaxation or fallback authority

route_classification.QUALIFIED: process succeeds, emits exactly 1024 accepted observation states, hard mass gate passes and O0/O2 scientific traces are bit-identical
route_classification.OUTSIDE_QUALIFIED_DOMAIN_NEAR_SATURATION: existing preregistered near-saturation/representation-bound exit, not a numerical-failure count
route_classification.BLOCKED_REFERENCE_NUMERICAL_QUALIFICATIO: existing fail-closed Reference numerical route blocks without physical-domain exit
route_classification.TECHNICAL_FAILURE: harness/infrastructure failure; blocks Q1 until repaired without changing science

temporal_qualification.temporary_numerical_reference: finest successful preregistered temporal route for that exact member/history
pairwise_metrics: maximum absolute per-layer storage difference at observation times
mean absolute per-layer storage difference at observation times
maximum absolute total-storage difference at observation times
maximum absolute terminal bottom-flux difference at observation times
temporal_qualification.qualified_case_rule: substeps 8 and 16 both QUALIFIED, their observation-grid difference is finite, and all available successive-refinement pair metrics are non-increasing toward the finest route within numerical equality
temporal_qualification.numerical_equality: max(1e-15,1e-10*max(1,previous_metric)) as inherited from DYN0A-CQ; numerical monotonicity only, not hydrological acceptance

R16_authority_reproduction_gate.source: existing DYN0A fine Reference fixed-flux authority
R16_authority_reproduction_gate.role: technical/scientific authority reproduction before reduced-grid viability is interpreted

outputs: qualified dynamic-case count by dimension and forcing regime
finest successful internal dt by case
minimum reduced dimension with at least one qualified dynamic case, if any
minimum reduced dimension with all physically in-domain dynamic cases qualified, if any

decisions.REDUCED_CORICHARDS_DYNAMIC_VIABILITY_EST: R16 reproduction passes and at least one R4/R5/R6/R8/R12 member has at least one non-EQ dynamic case temporally qualified.
decisions.ONLY_FINE_CORICHARDS_DYNAMIC_VIABLE: R16 reproduction passes, no R4-R12 non-EQ dynamic case qualifies, and R16 has at least one qualified dynamic case.
decisions.CORICHARDS_Q1_COMPARATOR_AUTHORITY_BLOCK: R16 reproduction fails, any TECHNICAL_FAILURE remains, or no R16 dynamic case is numerically qualified.

Q2_authorization.if_reduced_viability: Preregister paired LARE_RN versus CoRichards_RN fidelity comparison on the common LARE+CoRichards+fine-Reference qualified cohort. Q1 does not itself compare hydrological error.
Q2_authorization.if_only_fine: Close same-dimension reduced CoRichards comparator as unavailable on this bounded laboratory; do not infer LARE superiority from numerical robustness.
